name: Hierarchy / Tier Diagram
when_to_pick: Show a top-down structure of who sits above whom, or how tiers stack — most useful for the IB model (a Master IB above several sub-IBs above their traders), a partnership/commission hierarchy, account or membership tiers (Bronze -> Silver -> Gold), or a prop-firm progression of account sizes. An optional single apex node sits at the top; each level below is a row of one or more nodes, joined by branching connector lines. Pick this when the relationship is hierarchical (levels of an org/tier); for a sequence of actions use how_it_works_steps, for branching decisions use decision-tree, and for attrition through stages use funnel.

apex.description: Optional single node at the very top (e.g. the Master IB). Omit for a plain stack of tiers.

levels.description: Ordered levels from top to bottom. Each level is a row of sibling nodes.

label.description: Optional tier label shown above the row, e.g. 'Sub-IBs', 'Traders', 'Gold tier'.
